story_premise: You are watching a thriller that has already happened. At each pause, you choose which clue the film follows, and that changes what the ending means.

party_night.title: The Film Begins
party_night.narration: It starts like any other night. <break time="0.8s" /> Music too loud. Faces moving through the dark. <break time="1.1s" /> Then, somewhere beyond the party, everything changes.

security_cam.title: The Missing Moment
security_cam.narration: By morning, there is a missing moment. <break time="0.9s" /> A blurred landing. A silence nobody can explain. <break time="1.1s" /> The camera caught enough to accuse someone, but not enough to be certain.

sara_calls.title: Sara's Lie

question.text: If Cole asks, I was never near the stairs. That is the only way this does not ruin all of us.

stay_quiet.label: follow Sara's lie / protect Sara / keep her secret / stay with Sara / help Sara / trust Sara / cover for Sara

cant_lie.label: question the lie / expose the crack / doubt Sara / follow the truth / don't trust Sara / challenge Sara

sara_calls.narration: Sara calls before the police do. <break time="0.7s" /> Her voice is steady. Too steady. <break time="0.8s" /> She has already decided what to say.
sara_calls.decision_prompt: Sara is still on the line. Do we protect the lie, or question it?

detective_arrives.title: Cole's Camera

question.text: She says she was upstairs. The camera says someone in her coat crossed the landing at 11:04.

lie.label: hide the camera / protect the lie / keep watching Sara's version / help Sara / keep it hidden

truth.label: show the camera / follow Cole / reveal the footage / show the evidence / trust Cole

detective_arrives.narration: Cole does not raise his voice. He never has to. He lets the camera make the room smaller.
detective_arrives.decision_prompt: The footage is ready. Do we hide the camera, or show what it saw?

cole_pushes.title: The Evidence

question.text: Watch her hands. People lie with words. Their hands usually tell the truth first.

hold_the_lie.label: cut away / protect Sara / keep the lie intact / hide the evidence / help Sara

confess.label: zoom in / follow the hands / inspect the frame / look closer / check the frame

cole_pushes.narration: Four seconds. Rewind. Four seconds again. The scene is daring you to mistake motion for intent.
cole_pushes.decision_prompt: Cole rewinds the frame. Do we cut away, or look closer?

cole_follows_up.title: Frame 1432

question.text: There. Frame 1432. Sara is not pushing him. She is reaching for something behind him.

full_account.label: show the full frame / reveal everything / complete the evidence / show it all / full truth

partial.label: leave doubt / keep it unclear / hide the missing edge / keep it ambiguous

cole_follows_up.narration: The frame holds. A hand, a shoulder, the edge of someone else just outside the crop. One inch changes the story.
cole_follows_up.decision_prompt: The missing edge is visible. Do we reveal the full frame, or leave doubt?

sara_comes_over.title: Sara's Version

question.text: Pause it there. Before you decide what I am, look at who Daniel was blocking.

listen.label: rewind five minutes / hear Sara out / follow her clue / listen to Sara / give Sara time

already_called.label: cut to police / skip her explanation / end the scene / call police / don't listen

sara_comes_over.narration: Sara does not defend herself. She points to a corner of the frame, where the second version of the story has been waiting.
sara_comes_over.decision_prompt: Sara points offscreen. Do we rewind for her, or cut to police?

maya_calls.title: Maya's Angle

question.text: He had my phone. Sara was not chasing him. She was chasing what he stole from me.

bring_maya.label: bring Maya into frame / reveal her side / connect both stories / bring Maya in / listen to Maya

just_sara.label: stay with Sara / keep Maya offscreen / isolate the confession / just Sara / ignore Maya

maya_calls.narration: The missing angle has a voice now. Not Sara's. Maya's.
maya_calls.decision_prompt: Maya enters the story. Do we bring her into frame, or stay with Sara?

sara_reveals.title: The Fall

question.text: I pushed his hand away. He stepped back like he knew the stair was not there. I swear I tried to catch him.

believe_her.label: believe the reach / accept Sara's version / follow the rescue / believe Sara / trust Sara

dont_believe_her.label: read it as murder / reject Sara / follow suspicion / don't believe Sara / blame Sara

sara_reveals.narration: The fall finally plays without a cut. Somehow, that makes it less certain.
sara_reveals.decision_prompt: The fall is finally clear. Do we believe the reach, or read it as murder?

ending_complicit.title: COMPLICIT

question.text: Some stories survive because nobody looks at the part that hurts.

ending_complicit.narration: The cut protects Sara. Daniel becomes an accident. The ending feels peaceful because it refuses to look down.

ending_witness.title: THE CLEAN CUT

question.text: A camera does not know motive. It only knows who was there.

ending_witness.narration: The obvious footage wins. Sara is taken in. The case makes sense, which is usually when a story is most dangerous.

ending_witness_broken.title: TOO LATE

question.text: That frame should have been the beginning. Instead, it arrives at the end.

ending_witness_broken.narration: The full frame clears the shape of Sara's hand. It cannot clear the lie she told before anyone saw it.

ending_witness_doubt.title: SHADOW OF DOUBT

question.text: Enough to doubt. Not enough to know.

ending_witness_doubt.narration: The edge stays hidden. Doubt does what truth cannot: it opens every door and closes none of them.

ending_truth.title: TRUTH

question.text: I did not save him. But I tried.

ending_truth.narration: The movie chooses the reach over the shove. Daniel still falls. Sara still lies. Only the meaning changes.

ending_truth_together.title: UNITED

question.text: Now play it with all of us in the frame.

ending_truth_together.narration: Maya enters the frame, and the whole film tilts. Sara was not hiding a murder. She was hiding who Daniel had cornered first.

ending_betrayal.title: BETRAYED

question.text: You saw the same frame I did. You just needed it to mean something worse.

ending_betrayal.narration: The angle decides before the truth can speak. Sara becomes guilty because the frame needs someone to blame.

ending_alone.title: ALONE

question.text: Then you never get to know what was behind him.

ending_alone.narration: The explanation is cut. Sara disappears into the next scene, and the film leaves you holding the wrong question.
